description: A Windows tray app that reconnects a saved Wi-Fi profile when its network is absent.
notes: Requires Windows 11 and Microsoft Edge WebView2. Launching with an existing target or saving a target enables automatic Wi-Fi reconnect. Login startup is managed separately.
Verify the installed homing.exe file without launching it.
Companion skill: npx skills add Hezric/Homing -g (optional; use your own skill manager if you have one).
Scoop keeps the running executable at a fixed physical path under persist to retain tray placement across updates. Stop the app before updating. The first migration may require placing the icon once.

Portable settings and WebView2 data stay in persist/runtime/data. The first portable update copies existing APPDATA settings only if no portable file exists, and leaves the old copy in place. Updates belong to Scoop.
